prose: Bloomberg reports that Democratic gubernatorial wins in Texas, Georgia, Ohio and Pennsylvania may expose 50% of proposed US AI data-center additions to greater scrutiny and pushback. Developers planning dozens of large AI campuses across Texas were already facing obstacles.
highlights: Democratic governor wins in TX, GA, OH and PA may expose ~50% of proposed data-center additions to more scrutiny
basis: Error cache: Bloomberg paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
